record.context_brief: Least nonlocal energy for prescribed degree
record.original_question: For 1<p<∞ and integer degree d, let m_{p,d}=\inf\{\|f\|_{W^{1/p,p}}^p: f∈W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1), deg f=d\}. Is it true that m_{p,d}=|d|m_{p,1} for every integer d? Is the infimum defining m_{p,d} achieved? If the linearity formula fails, is there nevertheless an explicit formula for lim_{d→∞} m_{p,d}/d = \inf_{d>0} m_{p,d}/d?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5.4 ([26, Open Problems 22 and 23]). Let 1 < p < ∞. Is it true that mp,d = |d| mp,1 for all d ∈ Z? Is the Inf in (5.6) achieved? Assuming that (5.7) does not hold, is there an explicit formula for lim_{d→+∞} mp,d / d = inf_{d>0} mp,d / d?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For real numbers 1 < p < ∞ and integers d, consider the fractional Sobolev space W^{1/p,p}(S^1; S^1) of measurable maps f : S^1 → S^1 ⊂ ℂ (where S^1 denotes the unit circle) with finite Gagliardo seminorm

  [f]_{W^{1/p,p}}^p := ∫_{S^1} ∫_{S^1} |f(x) − f(y)|^p / |x − y|^2  dx dy,

equipped with the norm ‖f‖_{W^{1/p,p}}^p := ‖f‖_{L^p}^p + [f]_{W^{1/p,p}}^p. For any f ∈ W^{1/p,p}(S^1; S^1), the topological degree deg f ∈ ℤ is well-defined (via, e.g., a VMO/density argument: every such f can be approximated in W^{1/p,p} by smooth maps to S^1, and the degree of those smooth approximants stabilizes).

Define
  m_{p,d} := inf { ‖f‖_{W^{1/p,p}}^p : f ∈ W^{1/p,p}(S^1; S^1),  deg f = d }.

Answer the following questions:
(a) Does the equality m_{p,d} = |d| · m_{p,1} hold for every integer d and every 1 < p < ∞?
(b) Is the infimum defining m_{p,d} achieved (for d ≠ 0)?
(c) If the linearity in (a) fails, give an explicit formula for the limit
  lim_{d → +∞} m_{p,d} / d  =  inf_{d > 0} m_{p,d} / d.
artifact.category_tag: Fractional Sobolev maps and topological degree
artifact.status_search_result: The question concerns minimum fractional Sobolev energy in W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1) prescribed by topological degree. It is stated as an open problem in collections of open problems on Sobolev maps between manifolds (Brezis–Mironescu and related work). A targeted web search did not return any source claiming a proof of the linearity m_{p,d}=|d|m_{p,1}, attainment, or an explicit formula for the asymptotic ratio; the problem appears to still be open.

status_evidence.title: Another look at Sobolev spaces (Bourgain–Brezis–Mironescu)
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational paper on W^{s,p} fractional Sobolev norms and degree theory for S^1-valued maps; the structural questions about minima per degree are posed but not resolved here.
status_evidence.claim: The framework supporting the problem is established; the specific linearity and attainment questions are not settled in this line of literature.
